azure.review.function.application_insigh.title: Selected Function declares an Application Insights setting
azure.review.function.application_insigh.description: Checks the declared presence of at least one literal Application Insights connection setting on explicitly selected Functions. Telemetry delivery and destination validity are not tested.
remediation: Configure APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING for the selected Function.
Review telemetry ingestion and authentication separately.

azure.review.function.runtime_major4_upd.title: Selected classic Function declares the automatic major4 runtime update channel
azure.review.function.runtime_major4_upd.description: Checks the classic Function FUNCTIONS_EXTENSION_VERSION declaration for the automatic major4 update channel. Flex Consumption and custom container host versions use separate mechanisms; the resolved build is not tested.
remediation: Review compatibility and select ~4 on supported classic Function hosting.
Review deliberate support-directed build pins before changing them.
